This means a PMA can be registered, but you should verify the specific address and may face additional oversight or requirements.

That means you can register it, but the specific address will face strict zoning and risk verification—it’s not a simple ‘anywhere’ license.

In practice, that means foreign-owned PT PMAs cannot register this travel agency activity here—local authorities are not granting the required licenses for this line of business.
intel.whoThisIsFor: Entrepreneurs who want to sell ready-made travel packages, group tours, or pilgrimage trips directly to consumers or businesses under their own brand.

It also includes live broadcasting of theater performances, but excludes analog TV and on-demand streaming.

intel.whoThisIsFor: Foreign entrepreneurs wanting to build an office-equipment leasing business that supplies businesses with machines and furniture on a rental basis, without staff.

intel.whatItMeans: This covers retail sales of optical instruments and their accessories, such as binoculars, magnifying glasses, microscopes, and welding goggles, directly to end customers.
